title: galium obliquum var. alpicola
intro: Galium obliquum var. alpicola, commonly known as Alpine Bedstraw, is a plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Bedstraw include soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and providing relief from anxiety and insomnia. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
